title: Drop 2 Chords
summary: Four-note chords on four neighbouring strings, in every inversion, and how changing one note turns one chord into the next.

helpful.why: Every chord here has four notes: a root, a third, a fifth and a seventh.
The lesson names each dot, and where it sits on its string.
Names like C-7 and Cø7 tell you which notes are lowered.
